name: nft-accept-unrelated-then-drop-peer
description: the earlier accept matches someone else, so the drop still applies
setup: nft add chain inet f out "{ type filter hook output priority 0; policy accept; }"
nft add rule inet f out ip daddr 10.9.9.9 accept

action.spec: nft add rule inet f out ip daddr 10.5.5.2 drop
